name: calendar
description: A tiny static calendar that highlights the dates you care about, with a GitHub Actions job that reminds you on the day.

scripts.build: node scripts/validate-dates.mjs && node scripts/generate-reminders.mjs --out data/reminder.json && node scripts/build-web.mjs --strict && node scripts/check-web.mjs
scripts.preview: node scripts/validate-dates.mjs && node scripts/generate-reminders.mjs --out data/reminder.json && node scripts/build-web.mjs
